features.name: Empty Body
features.summary: Spend Ki to become invisible and resistant to most damage; can also project astrally.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.summary: Regain 4 Ki when initiative begins and none remain.

characters.progressionNote: Monk’s Warforged appearance remains locked as character identity and art. To avoid non-SRD ancestry mechanics, the sheet uses Human rules and the SRD Way of the Open Hand. Every former homebrew “chi” power is replaced by Ki, Open Hand Technique, Stunning Strike, Evasion, Diamond Soul, and Quivering Palm.

characters.name: Noldrack Goldblade

attacks.name: Produce Flame
attacks.notes: Ranged spell attack; also provides light.

features.name: Druidic and Spellcasting
features.summary: Use Wisdom for druid spells and speak the secret language of druids.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Transform into beasts twice per short or long rest; movement forms improve at levels 4 and 8.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.summary: Once per long rest, recover spell slots during a short rest with total levels up to half druid level.

features.name: Mountain Circle Spells
features.summary: Fixed circle spells are always prepared at the appropriate levels.

features.name: Land’s Stride
features.summary: Move through nonmagical difficult terrain and plants without penalty and resist magical plants.

features.name: Nature’s Ward
features.summary: Cannot be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey; immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature’s Sanctuary
features.summary: Beasts and plants must save before attacking you.

features.name: Timeless Body and Beast Spells
features.summary: Age slowly and cast many spells while using Wild Shape.

features.name: Archdruid
features.summary: Use Wild Shape without a normal use limit and ignore many spell components.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.summary: Concentration; a willing creature adds 1d4 to one ability check before the spell ends.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.summary: Create light in your hand or make a ranged spell attack for fire damage. Damage scales by tier.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.summary: Constitution save at close range; poison damage that scales by tier.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.summary: Melee spell attack at 30 feet; piercing damage and pull a Large or smaller creature up to 10 feet.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.summary: Concentration; plants restrain creatures that fail a Strength save in a 20-foot square.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.summary: Touch a creature to restore 1d8 + spellcasting modifier hit points; higher slots add 1d8.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.summary: Concentration; Dexterity save in a cube. Affected targets glow and attacks against them have advantage.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.summary: Constitution save in a 15-foot cube; thunder damage and push 10 feet on a failed save.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.summary: Concentration; create a movable sphere that burns nearby creatures and can ram a target as a bonus action.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.summary: Concentration; radiant damage in a movable cylinder when a creature enters or starts its turn there.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.summary: Concentration; chosen creatures gain +10 Dexterity (Stealth) and leave no tracks.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.summary: Concentration; a willing creature can move across walls and ceilings while keeping its hands free.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.summary: Concentration; camouflaged spikes make an area difficult terrain and damage creatures moving through it.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.summary: Concentration; call bolts into a storm cloud, dealing lightning damage in a small area.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.summary: End spells of 3rd level or lower automatically; higher-level spells require an ability check.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.summary: Concentration; heavily obscure an area, extinguish flames, create difficult terrain, and disrupt concentration.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.summary: Dexterity save in a 100-foot line; lightning damage, half on a successful save.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.summary: Step into a stone surface or object for up to 8 hours, perceiving time while hidden within it.

spells.name: Blight
spells.summary: Constitution save; heavy necrotic damage, with special effects against plants and no effect on undead or constructs.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.summary: Dexterity save in a cylinder; bludgeoning plus cold damage and difficult terrain for one round.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.summary: A creature ignores difficult terrain and magical speed reduction, and can escape restraints more easily for 1 hour.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.summary: Touch stone and form it into a chosen shape, including a simple opening or sealed passage.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.summary: Concentration; grant resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.summary: Create a temporary passage through wood, plaster, or stone.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.summary: Concentration; create stone panels that can become permanent if concentration lasts for the full duration.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.summary: End one major debilitating effect such as a curse, petrification, or ability-score/maximum-hit-point reduction.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.summary: Restore hit points to up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere.

spells.name: Heal
spells.summary: Restore 70 hit points and end blindness, deafness, and disease; higher slots restore more.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.summary: Concentration; create a damaging wall that heavily obscures and costs extra movement.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.summary: Dexterity save in arranged cubes; fire damage, half on success, with selective vegetation ignition.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.summary: A creature regains hit points immediately and each turn; severed body parts can regrow.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.summary: Concentration; gradually alter precipitation, temperature, and wind in a large outdoor area.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.summary: Constitution save in a large radius; radiant damage and blindness, especially effective against undead and oozes.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.summary: Concentration; transform yourself into other creatures while retaining key mental and class features.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.summary: Concentration; a vast storm produces escalating effects over multiple rounds.

characters.progressionNote: Noldrack already fits the SRD rules cleanly. His fixed Mountain circle and spell order emphasize stone, storms, survival, healing, and elemental control without retaining the legacy spell scaling.
